hi: Fakaalofa lahi atu, ko au ko AKSHRK
intro: Ko e tagata taute polokalama foou. Kua leveki e au e gahua talimalo server ASHIKA Network mo e lisi he tau server Minecraft SABALISU, mo e taute e au e polokalama server ma e Minecraft Storia.
about: Foou agaia au, ka e tohi e au e code he tau aho oti mo e kua mitaki atu
Tohi e au e **Python**, **Node.js** mo e **C#**
Kua leveki e au haku gahua talimalo server
Fakaalofa atu ke he tau hūhū hagaao ke he haku tau gahua po ke he technology: fakaalofa mai ni he Discord
can_write: Tau mena ne maeke ia au ke tohi (fakalataha mo e code fakamamahi)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: tau server mai he 30 yen he mahina
anw_p:
Ko e gahua talimalo ma lautolu ne manako ke fakagahua e server ka e nakai maeke ke fakaaoga e tupe loga.
Kamata ikiiki, **mai he 30 yen ni he mahina**.
sab_t: SABALISU: ko e lisi he tau server Minecraft
sab_p:
Tuku haau server Minecraft ke he lisi mo e kumi e tau tagata ke pele ai.
Aoga ma e tau tagata pele ne kumi server mo e tau iki ne manako ke fakakite haau server.
storia_t: Storia: polokalama server ma e tau server Minecraft lalahi
storia_p: Ko e fork open-source he Folia ma e Minecraft 26.2. Mo e **Storia Cluster**, maeke e lalolagi taha ke gahua he tau server loga he magaaho taha, mo e fano e tau tagata pele he vahā ha lautolu ka e nakai fai loading screen.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: ko e lalolagi taha ne fakafaitotonu he tau server loga, mo e tau fakafetuiaga fakagalogalo
**Relay fakatali**: ko e relay ke uaaki kua leveki e kopi mo e hukui e relay fakamua ka galo
**Linear format**: kua fakaaoga he lalolagi e vaega he disk space
**Lalolagi RAM**, **Tick Guard**, ko e plugin API ma e tau fakamaama fakafaitotonu, mo e falu foki
welcome: Fakaalofa atu ke he tau mena oti!
